text_block_list.name: Station Advertisement
text_block_list.text:
"—A moment of healing for hard-working you...
Our 'Relaxation Fair' is underway♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! They had something like that going on?
Lucky~ I wonder if there's any new merch out?
choice_data_list: Since we're nearby, want to drop by for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! Huh, are you sure!?
I'll gladly take you up on that offer, then~.
choice_data_list: Because I want to watch you grow, too.
Because I want to keep watching too.

text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been struggling to shake off the fatigue from work.
This might be a good opportunity.
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
âAh, a squishy cushion!
I've had my eye on this, too~.

I picked up the cushion Hishi Miracle had her eye on...
I see, this really is nice.
choice_data_list: Looks like we could use this for training.
Looks like we could use this for training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I sup... pose?
It does seem pretty handy for muscle training~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Still, shouldn't we just relax like normal first?
These are relaxation goods after all~"
choice_data_list: Oh, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Relaxation time’ is pretty important, after all.
It's fine to forget about work and take it easy for just today~."
Indeed, I came here to soothe my fatigue, so this is completely defeating the purpose. Composing myself, I head to the next shop.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this foot care stone is great~.
You can massage the soles of your feet while sitting down.
choice_data_list: This! Core trai—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: ...Looks like a great spot to rest after training!
...Looks like a great spot to rest after training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? I'd think using it normally
while doing desk work would be fine, though...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waterbeds sound so nice.
I hear they're super comfy to sleep on.
choice_data_list: Alright! I think I'll lie down for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm, excuse me, valued customer, I am terribly sorry.
This is strictly for display only...
choice_data_list: Whoa! I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so you make careless mistakes like that too, Trainer-san~. That's pretty rare, isn't it?

I'm just spinning my wheels.
Or rather, while trying to heal myself...
choice_data_list: (If anything, I'm feeling kind of worn out...)

text_block_list.text:
Having someone like me next to her would probably keep Hishi Miracle from relaxing.
Thinking that, I glanced over to check on her, and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the "Melt-Into-Butter Cushion."
I want one, but I can't afford it~.
Guess I'll just get some comfort here~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, my whole body feels like it's melting away~.
This is bad... I'm legit getting so sleepy...
choice_data_list: (...I'm genuinely feeling so soothed.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Everything in the interior here is round, huh?
The plump shapes are so cute~, it's really soothing."

Hishi Miracle speaks in such a relaxed, melting voice.
Seeing her so completely unwound in body and mind
warms my heart.
choice_data_list: You're good at 'healing yourself,' aren't you
You're really good at "healing yourself," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this all of a sudden~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I've always loved this kind of thing~
I've got all sorts of merch and stuff too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san, on the other hand... looks like they're bad with that?
choice_data_list: Yeah...
That's true...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha.
You're super serious, Trainer.
Maybe you should try learning a thing or two from me~
choice_data_list: ...That's it!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-What is...?
choice_data_list: Hishi Miracle-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes???
choice_data_list: —Please become my soothing Trainer!
—Please be my healing Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: I wanna know how to make time to relax and unwind.
I want to know how to make time to relax and unwind.

text_block_list.text:
After spending the whole day with her, I'm certain.
She's a master at unwinding.
She's the perfect person to learn from.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
N-No, well... Wouldn't it be better
to look it up online...? To find what suits you...
choice_data_list: I trust you more than the internet!
I trust you more than the internet!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
choice_data_list: You know more about me than the internet does... right?!
You know more about me than the internet does... right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh... Really? You think so?
choice_data_list: You're the only trainer for me!!
You're the only Trainer for me!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Only me, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... If you put it like that,
it'd feel kinda bad to turn you down~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Weeell, if it's strictly about relaxation? Maybe I know a tiny bit? More than average, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, well—shall we give it a little try?
choice_data_list: Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why does this whole situation
feel so familiar...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Well, whatever. For now, maybe next time we go out, we can just laze around and check out some relaxing spots~
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you, Trainer!
What should we do in the meantime?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, this feels so weird!
To think Trainer is a Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, since we're here, shall we go all out and whip you into shape~?
Just like Trainer usually does.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe study on my own? But I feel like I'd get way too carried away with it~.
choice_data_list: You catch on quickly...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we've spent quite a lot of time together, haven't we~?
Maybe I should make a rule like "Self-study forbidden!"?
